notes: UNVERIFIED. The recorded source was 'NIH Open-i / PubMed Central (open access)', which is not a licence — it describes how the article may be READ. The PMC Open Access Subset mixes CC BY (commercial use permitted) with CC BY-NC and CC BY-ND (it is not), and Open-i indexes all of them. scripts/datasets/setup_fundus.js kept only imgLarge and caption from the API response and discarded the article identifiers, so no image here can be traced to the paper it came from: resolving this means re-running the fetch capturing pmcid and licence, not looking something up. Until then these must be treated as not cleared for a product that is sold.
